snippet.title: Nightmare Journey 1135 – Short Trailer
snippet.description:
悪夢を彷徨う脱出ホラーゲーム『Nightmare Journey 1135』を制作中です。
ドット絵イベント「PixelArtPark8」で展示した試遊版の紹介映像です。
"Nightmare Journey 1135" is a psychological horror escape game currently in development.
This is a short teaser showing the demo version exhibited at Pixel Art Park 8.

Wishlist on Steam:
